summary.text: Jerry Moran was first elected to the U.S. Senate from Kansas in 2010.

paragraphs.text: Before the Senate he served seven terms in the U.S. House representing Kansas's "Big First" District and eight years in the Kansas State Senate, the last two as Majority Leader.
He attended Fort Hays State University, earned an economics degree and later a J.D. from the University of Kansas, and worked as a small-town banker.
